# scipix/tests/fixtures

Static fixtures consumed by the scipix tests.

## Subdirs

- `configs/` - TOML config fixtures (e.g. `test_config.toml`).
- `expected/` - Expected text outputs for known inputs (`simple_addition.txt`, `quadratic.txt`, `simple_fraction.txt`).

## Related

- Used by: `../unit/`, `../integration/`, `../common/`.
